runtime.contract: yyfbitshiftleft promotes a number operand to Long, then calls Long.shiftLeft. Colour alpha shifting therefore preserves positive 64-bit bits instead of truncating to signed JavaScript int32.

source_contract.color_function.gml:11: cola returns int64 of RGB low24 plus alpha byte shifted24.
source_contract.color_function.gml:37: make_color_rgba packs ascending R,G,B,A bytes and returns int64.
source_contract.node_color.gml:9: processData returns its raw colour input.
source_contract.string_decimal.gml:39-42: toNumber preserves existing int64 without real conversion.

native_profile.carrier: Colour byte fields Red, Green, Blue, Alpha reconstruct one exact int64 between 0 and 4294967295.
native_profile.conversion: R | G<<8 | B<<16 | A<<24 using uint32 intermediates, followed by lossless int64 conversion.
native_profile.scope: Argument Number mode converts bounded native Colour. String mode retains Colour unchanged. This does not recover arbitrary original numeric colour bits outside uint32 or claim source surface handle identity.
